title: Confidence Update Rate Before Deadlines
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:personal horizon_bucket=* confidence_updated=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(confidence_updated="yes",1,0))) as matched by horizon_bucket
| eval a_confidence_update_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_confidence_update_pct
description: Measures the percentage of open forecasts that end with a confidence update by horizon bucket.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which horizon bucket are helping or hurting open forecasts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a confidence update` on `forecast:personal` events and summarize the hit rate by `horizon_bucket`.
visualization: Table of horizon bucket with percentage of open forecasts ending with a confidence update.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how often a confidence update happens for each horizon bucket so you can see where open forecasts go smoothly or get stuck.
